entries.task_id: the buddha|was|staying near sāvatthī in jeta’s grove
entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.description: There they’d see a large elephant’s footprint
entries.subject: There

spans.text: There they’d see a large elephant’s footprint, long and broad.

entries.description: Then they’d come to the conclusion
entries.subject: Then

spans.text: So niṭṭhaṁ gacchati: Then they’d come to the conclusion, ‘ayameva so mahānāgo’ti. ‘This is that big bull elephant.’

entries.description: Realized One arises in the world
entries.subject: Realized One

spans.text: In the same way, brahmin, a Realized One arises in the world, perfected, a fully awakened Buddha, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, holy, knower of the world, supreme guide for those fit for training, teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.

entries.description: teaches Dhamma that’s good in the beginning
entries.subject: teaches Dhamma

spans.text: He teaches Dhamma that’s good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, meaningful and well-phrased.

entries.description: spiritual practice that’s entirely complete and pure
entries.subject: spiritual practice

spans.text: And he reveals a spiritual practice that’s entirely complete and pure.

entries.task_id: why|don’t|i shave off my hair and beard
entries.description: Why don’t I shave off my hair and beard
entries.subject: Why
entries.object: I shave off my hair and beard

spans.text: Yannūnāhaṁ kesamassuṁ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṁ pabbajeyyan’ti. Why don’t I shave off my hair and beard, dress in ocher robes, and go forth from the lay life to homelessness?’

In the same way, brahmin, a Realized One arises in the world, perfected, a fully awakened Buddha, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, holy, knower of the world, supreme guide for those fit for training, teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.
And he reveals a spiritual practice that’s entirely complete and pure.
He teaches Dhamma that’s good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, meaningful and well-phrased.
